title: Lucky Draw: 150 Scratch, Prize Wheel, Lottery and Bingo SFX
shortText: 150 scratch card, prize wheel, lottery, bingo and raffle sounds, with loops.
html:
Lucky Draw is 150 scratch card, prize wheel, lottery and bingo sound effects for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker and any game engine.

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. A free demo of 16 sounds is on this page.

@@IMG:shot_0_a_draw.gif@@

What is inside

150 sounds · 28 seamless loops · 12 ladders · WAV + OGG · 16 sound free demo

  • Scratch cards (39 files): silver foil, gold foil and grey latex, each at three speeds as a seamless loop that plays while the pointer drags, plus strokes, cells clearing, symbols matching and the result.
  • Prize wheels (29): a tabletop, booth and carnival wheel, each with a spin start, three tick speeds, a stop, a near miss that falls back a segment, and single peg ticks.
  • The lottery draw (21): a ball drum at three loads, an air machine, the chute, the cradle and a number board.
  • Bingo (24): a cage at three crank speeds, an ink dauber, marker discs, and a line, two lines and a full house.
  • The raffle (16): a tin drum of paper tickets, torn, drawn and unfolded.
  • Wins and the counter (21): five win tiers from a small prize to the jackpot, a cash box, a ticket printer, a desk bell and tokens.

@@IMG:shot_1_the_booth.png@@

Every waveform is a shipped file.

@@IMG:shot_3_the_scratch_grid.png@@

Each coating climbs in brightness with drag speed.

Works with

Unity, Unreal, Godot 4, GameMaker, RPG Maker MV and MZ, and HTML5: use the WAV or OGG files directly. Loop points are written into the loop files. Import notes are in the readme.

The five win tiers keep the timing of the win ladder in our slot machine pack, so the two can sit in one game.

Try it free

The demo holds a whole scratch card, a wheel from throw to stop, a lottery ball from gate to cradle, the dauber, a raffle ticket and two win tiers.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the sounds as a pack. Every sound is synthesised in code, with no generative audio model, samples or recordings. The code and the cover art were made with AI tools. Nothing here is a tune or a voice, and there are no number callouts.

Versions

v1.0.0: first release, 150 sounds.

More from the same studio

  • Reelhouse: Slot Machine Sound Effects, the reels, the hopper and the casino floor.
  • Tilt: Pinball and Pachinko Sound Effects, a wooden table and a pachinko machine.
  • Shuffle and Tell: the Deckbuilder Card Table, cards, chips and the table.
